title: The median sits on the boundary between the two halves, so it's always a top
caption: Stream 5 15 1 3 8. lo is a max-heap of the small half and hi a min-heap of the large half. Every value in lo ≤ every value in hi, and len(lo) is len(hi) or len(hi) + 1.

frames.text: 5 arrives and goes into lo. The count is odd, so the median is lo's top: 5.
15 > 5, so it goes into hi. The count is even, so the median is (top of lo + top of hi) / 2 = (5 + 15) / 2 = 10.
1 ≤ 5 goes into lo. lo is one bigger than hi, which is allowed. The median is lo's top: 5.
3 ≤ 5 goes into lo, so lo is now two bigger than hi. Move lo's top (5) to hi. The median is (3 + 5) / 2 = 4.
8 > 3 goes into hi, so hi is now bigger than lo. Move hi's top (5) back to lo. The small half is 1 3 5 and the large half is 8 15. The median is 5.
